questions.question: Putti platt surgical procedure to repair recurrent dislocation involves:
questions.explanation: Putti-Platt repair shortens subscapularis (and the anterior capsule) to treat recurrent anterior dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bilateral symmetrical pseudo fractures are seen most commonly in:
questions.explanation: Looser's zones (pseudofractures) are bilateral and symmetrical in osteomalacia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Complete diappearance of shadow of lesser trochanter in anteroposterior view of X-ray indicates:
questions.explanation: With posterior dislocation the femur is internally rotated so the lesser trochanter shadow disappears.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: An old epileptic patient presented with a complaint of pain in both temporal regions and inability to close her mouth after episode of fits. The patient had similar problem 3 times in the past. Most probable diagnosis of the above case is:
questions.explanation: Recurrent bilateral jaw locking after seizures indicates temporomandibular joint dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: An old epileptic patient presented with a complaint of pain in both temporal regions and inability to close her mouth an after episode of fit. The patient had similar problem 3 times in the past, which of the following would be confirmatory for definite diagnosis:
questions.explanation: X-ray or CT confirms the dislocation of the condyle in front of the articular eminence.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All of the following are problems produced by multiple hereditary osteochondromatosis except:
questions.explanation: Multiple hereditary exostoses cause bony swellings, deformity and short stature but not anaemia or jaundice.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All is true about multiple osteochondrometosis except:

options.B: Swelling stops growing after skeletal maturation

questions.explanation: Hereditary multiple exostoses do not cause emaciation or anaemia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: X-ray characteristics of giant cell tumor:
questions.explanation: Giant cell tumour shows a soap-bubble appearance on X-ray.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The best treatment in flail chest is:
questions.explanation: Severe flail chest with respiratory failure needs positive-pressure ventilation (internal pneumatic stabilisation) with analgesia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In congenital dislocation of knee deformity seen is:
questions.explanation: Congenital dislocation of the knee shows hyperextension (genu recurvatum).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Multiple hereditary osteochondrometosis presents all of the following problems except:
questions.explanation: Anaemia and toxaemia are not features of hereditary multiple exostoses.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Paraplegia in tuberculosis is most common in which region of the spine?
questions.explanation: Paraplegia in spinal TB is commonest with dorsal (thoracic) spine disease.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Gastronemius resection is done most commonly in:
questions.explanation: Gastrocnemius recession/resection is done most often for equinus in clubfoot.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following is correct female preponderance ratio in DDH?
questions.explanation: Hormonal (maternal oestrogen/relaxin) influence explains the female preponderance in DDH.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All are the features of spinal tuberculosis except:
questions.explanation: Spinal tuberculosis causes kyphosis, abscess and paraplegia, not scoliosis typically.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which surgical technique is commonly performed on a shoulder to repair a defect in the glenoid labrum?
questions.explanation: The Bankart procedure repairs a detached anteroinferior glenoid labrum.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Musculoskeletal abnormalities in neurofibromatosis is:
questions.explanation: Neurofibromatosis causes limb hypertrophy, scoliosis and pseudoarthrosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Treatment of CTEV should begin: 158 E 159 B 160 B 161 D Exercise Therapy
questions.explanation: Treatment of clubfoot should begin soon after birth.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Soft tissue calcification around the knee is seen in:
questions.explanation: Pseudogout causes soft-tissue calcification around the knee.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In pseudogout features include:

options.A: Involvement of smaller joints and uric acid crystals
options.B: Involvement of large joints and calcium pyrophosphate crystals
options.C: Involvement of large joints and hypercalcemia
options.D: Involvement of large joins and uric acid crystals

questions.explanation: Pseudogout affects large joints with calcium pyrophosphate crystals.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Perthe's disease is characterized by:

options.A: Painful hip in childhood and avascular necrosis of femoral head
options.B: Fracture displacement of neck of femur in an adolescent

questions.explanation: Perthes' disease is avascular necrosis of the femoral head with a painful hip in childhood.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Greenstick fracture generally occurs in:
questions.explanation: Greenstick fractures occur in children.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most important pathology in club foot is:
questions.explanation: Talonavicular subluxation/dislocation is considered the key pathology of clubfoot.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following is characteristic feature of Charcot's joint? [Essential Orthopaedics/Maheshwari/3rd Ed./Pg. 166}
questions.explanation: A Charcot joint is painless, swollen and unstable (hypermobile).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The commonest deformity at hip in post polio residual paralysis is:
questions.explanation: Post-polio hip deformity is typically flexion, abduction and external rotation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Meniscial calcification is a feature of:
questions.explanation: Meniscal calcification is typical of pseudogout.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Recurrent clubfoot is due to failure of development of:
questions.explanation: Recurrent clubfoot is related to inadequate Achilles tendon lengthening or hypoplastic tendo calcaneus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The early feature of Pott's paraplegia is:
questions.explanation: Flexor spasm is an early feature of Pott's paraplegia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: K-wire is used in:
questions.explanation: K-wires are used for cerclage, fixing small bones and temporary fixation before plating.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Triangular relation of elbow is in:
questions.explanation: The triangular relation of the elbow is preserved in supracondylar fracture but lost in dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Anterior dislocation of shoulder causes all except:
questions.explanation: Anterior shoulder dislocation does not cause hip bone fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common cause of neuropathic joints:
questions.explanation: Diabetes is the commonest cause of neuropathic joints.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In a newborn child, abduction and internal rotation produces a click sound. It is known as:
questions.explanation: Ortolani's sign is the click of reduction on abducting a dislocated infant hip.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Club foot seen in a 15-year-old could be treated successfully by:
questions.explanation: In an adolescent with rigid clubfoot, triple arthrodesis is the successful treatment.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Convex foot arch is seen in:
questions.explanation: A convex (rocker-bottom) foot is typical of congenital vertical talus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In correction of clubfoot by manipulation, which deformity should be corrected first?
questions.explanation: In manipulation of clubfoot, forefoot adduction is corrected first.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Pathognomic sign of traumatic fracture:
questions.explanation: Crepitus is the pathognomonic sign of fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common mode of metastasis in osteogenic sarcoma:
questions.explanation: Osteosarcoma metastasises through the blood.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest deformity in congenital dislocation of hip:
questions.explanation: Abnormal femoral torsion (anteversion) is a common deformity in congenital hip dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All are seen in osteogensis imperfecta except:
questions.explanation: Joint dislocation is not a typical feature of osteogenesis imperfecta, which shows ligament laxity and blue sclera.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dashboard injury cases:
questions.explanation: Dashboard injury causes posterior dislocation of the hip.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common cause of septic arthritis in all ages:
questions.explanation: Staphylococcus aureus is the commonest cause of septic arthritis overall.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: March Fracture is:

options.A: Stress fracture of neck of second metatarsal
options.B: Stress fracture of neck of talus

questions.explanation: March fracture is a stress fracture of the second metatarsal (neck/shaft) from repetitive loading.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest complication of extra capsular fracture of neck of femur is:
questions.explanation: Malunion (usually varus) is the commonest complication of extracapsular (trochanteric) neck-of-femur fractures; they rarely develop avascular necrosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Nonunion in long bones is treated by:

options.D: Open reduction and internal fixation with bone grafting

questions.explanation: Established non-union of a long bone needs open reduction, internal fixation and bone grafting.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bennet's fracture is fracture dislocation of base of metacarpal:
questions.explanation: Bennett fracture is a fracture-dislocation of the base of the first metacarpal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Patient when comes with fracture femur in an acute accident, the first thing to do:

options.A: Secure airway and treat the shock

questions.explanation: In a trauma patient with a femoral fracture, airway and shock management take priority over splinting or X-rays.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which is not a principle of compound fracture treatment?
questions.explanation: Compound fractures are debrided and covered with antibiotics but the wound is not closed immediately because of infection risk.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Treatment after removal of plaster for supracondylar fracture of humerus is:
questions.explanation: After a supracondylar fracture, active mobilisation is encouraged; passive stretching and massage risk myositis ossificans.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common type of Supracondylar fracture is
questions.explanation: The extension type accounts for most supracondylar fractures of the humerus in children.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The most preferred treatment of fracture of neck of femur in young person is:
questions.explanation: In a young patient an intracapsular neck-of-femur fracture is treated by urgent reduction and internal fixation to preserve the head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: After a fall from a height calcaneal fracture is associated with fracture of:
questions.explanation: A fall from a height causing a calcaneal fracture is often associated with vertebral (lumbar) compression fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site of fracture scaphoid:
questions.explanation: The waist is the commonest site of scaphoid fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Treatment at choice or fracture neck of humerus in a 70-year-old male:
questions.explanation: Most proximal humeral fractures in elderly patients are treated conservatively with analgesia and a sling followed by early motion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Late complication of acetabular fracture:

options.A: Avascular necrosis of head of femur
options.C: Fixed deformity of the hip joint

questions.explanation: Secondary osteoarthritis of the hip is the commonest late complication of acetabular fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Least Common complication of colle's fracture:
questions.explanation: Non-union is rare in Colles fracture; malunion, stiffness and Sudeck dystrophy are more common.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common site of fracture in osteoporosis:
questions.explanation: The vertebral body is the commonest site of osteoporotic fracture (followed by hip and wrist).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A Bennet's fracture is difficult to maintain in reduced position because of the pull of:
questions.explanation: In Bennett fracture the abductor pollicis longus pulls the metacarpal shaft proximally and makes reduction hard to hold.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Clinical Orthopedic Rehabilitation/Brotzman 2nd Ed.

questions.question: Avascular necrosis is commonest in one of the following fractures:
questions.explanation: Displaced Garden III and IV fractures of the femoral neck carry the highest risk of avascular necrosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Carpal bone which fractures commonly:
questions.explanation: The scaphoid is the most commonly fractured carpal bone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In supracondylar fracture, the segment is often displaced:
questions.explanation: In the extension type the distal fragment is displaced posteriorly.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopaedics and Applied Physiotherapy/Jayant Joshi/Pg. 89

questions.question: The last step in the healing a fracture is:

options.D: Callus formation E. Demineralization of bones

questions.explanation: Remodelling is the last stage of fracture healing, after haematoma, soft/hard callus and consolidation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: An army recruit, smoker and 6 months into training started complaining of pain at posterior medial aspect of both legs. There was acute point tenderness and the pain was aggravated on physical activity. The most likely diagnosis is:
questions.explanation: Medial-sided shin pain in a trained recruit with point tenderness suggests a tibial stress fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Shepherd's Crooke's deformity is seen in:
questions.explanation: Shepherd's crook deformity of the proximal femur is characteristic of fibrous dysplasia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site for Osteogenic sarcomas:
questions.explanation: The lower end of the femur is the commonest site of osteosarcoma.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sun ray appearance is seen in:
questions.explanation: Sunray (sunburst) periosteal reaction is characteristic of osteosarcoma.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Turek'sl, Lippincott Ravan/4th Ed./Pg. 737-738

questions.question: Tumor arising from Diaphysis:
questions.explanation: Ewing sarcoma typically arises in the diaphysis of long bones, whereas osteosarcoma is metaphyseal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most radiosensitive bone tumor is:
questions.explanation: Ewing sarcoma is highly radiosensitive.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bony ankyIosis result from:
questions.explanation: Pyogenic arthritis tends to end in bony ankylosis, whereas tuberculous arthritis leads to fibrous ankylosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Onion peel appearance in X-ray suggests:
questions.explanation: Onion-peel periosteal reaction suggests Ewing sarcoma.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Soap bubble appearance in X-ray suggests:
questions.explanation: A soap-bubble appearance suggests giant cell tumour (osteoclastoma).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Infarction of the distal epiphysis of the second metatarsal bone is:
questions.explanation: Freiberg disease is osteochondritis of the second metatarsal head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The gold standard for the diagnosis of osteoporosis is:
questions.explanation: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DEXA) is the standard method of measuring bone mineral density.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site of a bone cyst:
questions.explanation: The upper end of the humerus is the commonest site of a solitary bone cyst.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The lytic lesion in the epiphysis in children is seen in:
questions.explanation: Chondroblastoma is a lytic epiphyseal lesion in children.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteochondritis dessicans occurs at:
questions.explanation: Osteochondritis dissecans classically affects the lateral surface of the medial femoral condyle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Rare site of metastasis in bone:
questions.explanation: Metastases below the elbow and knee are rare.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sclerosis of bone is seen in all except:
questions.explanation: Hyperparathyroidism causes bone resorption, not sclerosis; fluorosis, osteopetrosis and prostate secondaries are sclerotic.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common cause of pathological fracture in a child is:
questions.explanation: A simple bone cyst is the commonest cause of pathological fracture in a child.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest benign tumor under 21 years of age:
questions.explanation: Osteochondroma is the commonest benign bone tumour in young people.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A boy presenting with swelling of lower end femur with calcified, nodular shadow in lung has:
questions.explanation: A swelling at the lower femur with lung nodules in a boy suggests osteosarcoma with pulmonary metastases.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common joint where arthroscopy is performed is:
questions.explanation: The knee is the joint in which arthroscopy is most often performed.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Earliest feature of TB vertebra:
questions.explanation: Pain is the earliest feature of spinal tuberculosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Marble bone disease is also known as:
questions.explanation: Marble bone disease is osteopetrosis (Albers-Schonberg disease).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site of chondroblastoma:
questions.explanation: Chondroblastoma arises in the epiphysis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Flexion, adduction and internal rotation is characteristic posture in:
questions.explanation: Posterior hip dislocation presents with a shortened limb held in flexion, adduction and internal rotation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dislocation of which one of the following carpal bones can present as median nerve palsy?
questions.explanation: Volar dislocation of the lunate can compress the median nerve in the carpal tunnel.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Karim Khan, Mcg Raw.hill/3rd Ed./Pg. 318

questions.question: Treatment of anterior dislocation of shoulder is by:
questions.explanation: Anterior shoulder dislocation is reduced by Kocher or traction-countertraction manoeuvres.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Pulled elbow is:
questions.explanation: Pulled elbow is subluxation of the radial head at the proximal radioulnar joint (annular ligament slip) in a young child.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Recurrent dislocation of patella is most often associated with:
questions.explanation: Recurrent patellar dislocation is associated with patella alta, genu valgum and a shallow trochlear groove.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest type of shoulder dislocation:
questions.explanation: Anterior (subcoracoid) dislocation is the commonest form of shoulder dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bilateral symmetrical idiopathic fractures are most commonly seen in:
questions.explanation: Osteogenesis imperfecta is the classic cause of multiple fractures with minimal trauma in childhood.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tuberculous arthritis in advanced cases leads to:
questions.explanation: Tuberculous arthritis heals with fibrous ankylosis, whereas pyogenic arthritis tends to bony ankylosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tuberculosis of the spine starts in:
questions.explanation: Spinal tuberculosis most often begins in the vertebral body adjacent to the disc (paradiscal) and spreads to the disc.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Organism causing osteomyelitis in sickle cell anemia:
questions.explanation: Salmonella is the characteristic organism of osteomyelitis in sickle cell disease.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Pathological changes in Caisson's disease is due to:
questions.explanation: Caisson disease (decompression sickness) is caused by nitrogen bubbles coming out of solution; it can cause avascular necrosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Not associated with osteogenesis imperfecta is:
questions.explanation: Osteogenesis imperfecta features blue sclerae, deafness and fractures; cataract is not typical.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Weaver's bottom is:

options.A: Eczematous lesion over buttocks of weaver's due to then sedentary position

questions.explanation: Weaver's bottom is ischiogluteal bursitis from prolonged sitting on hard surfaces.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site of skeletal tuberculosis is:
questions.explanation: The spine is the commonest site of skeletal tuberculosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteomyelitis of the spine is mostly caused by:
questions.explanation: Staphylococcus aureus is the commonest cause of pyogenic osteomyelitis of the spine.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Enchondroma commonly arises from
questions.explanation: Enchondromas most often arise in the phalanges and metacarpals of the hand.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which joint is not fused in Triple arthrodesis:
questions.explanation: Triple arthrodesis fuses the subtalar, talonavicular and calcaneocuboid joints; the tibiotalar (ankle) joint is not fused.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Diabetic charcot's joint affect most commonly:
questions.explanation: Diabetic neuropathic (Charcot) arthropathy most commonly involves the tarsal joints of the foot.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common cause of hemarthrosis knee joint is:

options.D: Medial meniscus tear E. Lateral meniscus tear

questions.explanation: Anterior cruciate ligament tear is the commonest cause of acute haemarthrosis of the knee after injury.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tuberculosis of the spine is known as:
questions.explanation: Tuberculosis of the spine is Pott disease.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Jefferson's fracture occurs at:
questions.explanation: Jefferson fracture is a burst fracture of the ring of the atlas (C1) from axial loading.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Vertical striations on vertebral bodies are seen in:
questions.explanation: Vertical striations (corduroy appearance) in a vertebral body suggest haemangioma.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site of TB spine:
questions.explanation: The dorsolumbar (thoracolumbar) region is the commonest site of spinal tuberculosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Schmoni's node is:

options.A: Radiological finding protruded nucleus pulposus into the vertebral body
options.B: Soft tissue tumor in relation to the vertebral
options.C: A tumor in the vertebral disk

questions.explanation: A Schmorl node is herniation of nucleus pulposus into the vertebral body.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopaedic Medicine/vol-1 Cyriax/5th Ed./Pg. 245

questions.question: Most unstable spinal injury is:
questions.explanation: Flexion-rotation (fracture-dislocation) injuries disrupt all three columns and are the most unstable.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteitis fibrosa cystica is seen in:
questions.explanation: Osteitis fibrosa cystica (brown tumours) is the bone disease of hyperparathyroidism.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In Volkman's ischemia, surgery should be done:
questions.explanation: Impending Volkmann ischaemic contracture is a surgical emergency needing immediate decompression/fasciotomy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Pain in osteoid osteoma is specifically relieved by:
questions.explanation: Pain of osteoid osteoma is characteristically relieved dramatically by salicylates/NSAIDs.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteogenic sarcoma metastasizes to commonly:
questions.explanation: Osteosarcoma metastasises early by blood, most often to the lungs.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: lntervertebral disc prolapse is treated chemically by:
questions.explanation: Chymopapain chemonucleolysis was used to dissolve the nucleus pulposus in disc prolapse.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Chemical synovectomy is done by:
questions.explanation: Osmic acid (and radioactive isotopes) are used for chemical synovectomy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Fat embolism is associated with:

options.D: Bruise below the line of lesion

questions.explanation: Fat embolism syndrome presents with petechial haemorrhages (chest, axillae), hypoxia and confusion after long-bone fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The following is false of Achondroplasia:
questions.explanation: Achondroplasia is an autosomal dominant FGFR3 mutation with limb shortening; intelligence is normal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Avascular necrosis of the head of femur is not seen in:
questions.explanation: Intertrochanteric (extracapsular) fractures rarely cause avascular necrosis because the head blood supply remains intact.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Trident hand is seen in:
questions.explanation: Trident hand is typical of achondroplasia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteoclastoma is common in age group of:
questions.explanation: Giant cell tumour is commonest between 20 and 40 years of age after physeal closure.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: When a person reports with vertebral fracture, hemiplegia and urinary retention the acute measure to be taken is:
questions.explanation: With retention of urine after spinal injury, immediate catheterisation is used to drain the bladder.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopaedics and Applied Physiotherapy/Jayant Joshi/Pg. 139

questions.question: Not a complication of menopause:
questions.explanation: Postmenopausal osteoporosis causes vertebral, Colles and neck-of-femur fractures; supracondylar fracture of the humerus is a childhood injury.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following arises from epiphysis?
questions.explanation: Giant cell tumour (osteoclastoma) arises in the epiphysis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All of following conditions may be responsible for osteoporosis except:
questions.explanation: Hyperparathyroidism, steroids and immobilisation cause bone loss; hypoparathyroidism does not.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The type of displacement of fractured fragment in which bone is not remodeled:
questions.explanation: Rotational deformity is not corrected by remodelling, whereas angulation in the plane of joint motion is.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Accessory navicular is called:
questions.explanation: The accessory navicular is also called os tibiale externum.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Ideal site for bone graft harvesting:
questions.explanation: The iliac crest is the usual donor site for cancellous bone graft.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Ivory osteoma commonly arises in the:
questions.explanation: Ivory osteomas arise from the skull (frontal and ethmoid sinuses).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest site of multiple myeloma:
questions.explanation: The vertebrae are the commonest site of multiple myeloma.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Gallow's traction is given for fracture of:
questions.explanation: Gallows (Bryant) traction is used for femoral shaft fractures in young children.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Who is acclaimed worldwide for total joint replacement?
questions.explanation: Sir John Charnley pioneered low-friction total hip replacement.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Rocker bottom foot results from:
questions.explanation: Rocker-bottom foot results from congenital vertical talus or over-corrected club foot.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Hill Sach's lesion is:
questions.explanation: The Hill-Sachs lesion is a compression defect of the posterolateral humeral head after anterior shoulder dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Airplane splint is used for:
questions.explanation: The airplane (abduction) splint is used in brachial plexus palsy to keep the arm abducted.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Macewen's osteotomy is performed in cases of:
questions.explanation: Macewen supracondylar osteotomy corrects genu valgum.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: CTEV is should be treated at the age of:
questions.explanation: Treatment of CTEV begins soon after birth with serial manipulation and casting (Ponseti).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Triple deformity of knee is seen in:
questions.explanation: Triple deformity of the knee (flexion, posterior subluxation, external rotation) is typical of advanced tuberculous arthritis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The cause of the gun stork deformity is:
questions.explanation: Gunstock deformity (cubitus varus) follows malunited supracondylar fracture of the humerus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Mallet finger is:

options.A: Avulsion fracture of extensor tendon of distal phalanx

questions.explanation: Mallet finger is avulsion of the extensor tendon from the distal phalanx.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Triradiate pelvis is seen in:
questions.explanation: Triradiate pelvis is a deformity seen in rickets and osteomalacia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Cryptorchidism is a condition in which:

options.C: Incomplete descend of testes in newborn

questions.explanation: Cryptorchidism is incomplete descent of the testis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The commonest variety of renal stone is:
questions.explanation: Calcium oxalate is the commonest type of renal stone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A physician suspects a stress fracture in a 16- year-old distance runner after completing a physical examination. Assuming the physician's preliminary diagnosis is correct, which of the following diagnostic tests would be the most appropriate to identify the stress fracture?
questions.explanation: A bone scan is the most sensitive early investigation for a stress fracture when X-rays are normal (MRI is also highly sensitive).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Essential basic treatment of domestic dog bites are all of the following except:
questions.explanation: Dog-bite management includes wound cleaning/debridement, tetanus and rabies prophylaxis and antibiotics; steroids have no role.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A 24-year-old male known epileptic presented with pain in the right shoulder region. Examination revealed that the right upper limb was adducted and internally rotated and the movements could not be performed. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: A shoulder held adducted and internally rotated that cannot be moved after a seizure is the classic posterior dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sprain is an injury to:

options.A: A ligament or joint capsule with or without dislocation
options.C: A ligament or joint capsule without dislocation

questions.explanation: A sprain is injury to a ligament or joint capsule without dislocation of the joint.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A joint least likely to develop recurrent dislocation: .
questions.explanation: The hip is the joint least prone to recurrent dislocation because of its deep, stable socket.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopedic Physical Assessment/Magee/3rd Ed./Pg 506

questions.question: A 72-year-old female involved in a motor vehicle accident fractures the middle third of her femoral shaft. The patient's physician is concerned about the effects of prolonged bed rest and would like the patient to begin walking as soon as possible. Which form of treatment would facilitate early weight bearing through the involved extremity?

options.A: Immobilization in a hip spica caste
options.B: Internal fixation with an intramedullary nail

questions.explanation: Intramedullary nailing allows early weight bearing and mobilisation for a femoral shaft fracture in the elderly.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A 26-year-old female presents with a diagnosis of recurrent patella dislocation. Which direction does the patella most often dislocate:
questions.explanation: The patella dislocates laterally because the quadriceps pull is lateral to the line of the tibial tubercle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient is referred to physical therapy after sustaining a complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The patient's ligament injury is best described as a:
questions.explanation: A complete ligament tear is a grade III sprain.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient is treated in physical therapy after injuring his hamstrings. The medical chart describes the injury as an avulsion fracture of the ischial tuberosity. This injury usually results from:

options.A: Forceful extension of the hip with an extended knee
options.B: Forceful extension of the hip with a flexed knee
options.C: Forceful flexion of the hip with an extended knee
options.D: Forceful flexion of the hip with a flexed knee

questions.explanation: Ischial tuberosity avulsion occurs with forceful hip flexion with the knee extended (e.g. sprinting or hurdling split).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All are predisposing factors of osteogenic sarcoma, except:
questions.explanation: Paget disease, radiation and bone infarcts predispose to osteosarcoma; viral infection is not a recognised predisposing factor.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All the following are causes of coxa-vara except:
questions.explanation: Coxa vara (neck-shaft angle below 120 degrees) results from malunion, congenital causes, rickets and osteomalacia, not from hip dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A building contractor suddenly complains of lower backache which increases on bending down he has:
questions.explanation: Sudden backache aggravated by bending in a manual worker suggests lumbar disc prolapse.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Fat embolism is commonly due to:
questions.explanation: Fat embolism is commonest after long-bone fractures such as the femur.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The most common nerve involved in Volkamann's ischemia contracture of forearm includes:
questions.explanation: The median nerve (and flexor digitorum profundus/flexor pollicis longus) is most affected in Volkmann ischaemic contracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In which of the following conditions numerous white spots are seen on the X-rays of many bones.
questions.explanation: Osteopoikilosis shows numerous small sclerotic (white) spots in many bones on X-ray.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The most common deformity in clubfoot is:
questions.explanation: Congenital talipes equinovarus (clubfoot) is the commonest club foot deformity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Carrying angle is decreased in:
questions.explanation: Carrying angle is reduced (or reversed) in cubitus varus and increased in cubitus valgus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dupuytren's contracture at the hand commonly starts in:

options.C: Middle finger E. Little finger only (BIHAR 1991)

questions.explanation: Dupuytren contracture most often affects the ring finger, then the little finger.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Galeazzi fracture is:

options.B: Fracture of the distal radius with inferior radioulnar joint dislocation
options.C: Fracture of radius in the proximal site and dislocation of the elbow.

questions.explanation: Galeazzi fracture is a fracture of the distal radial shaft with dislocation of the distal radioulnar joint.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following fracture are best managed by closed means? (AIIMS May 2012)

options.A: Fracture both means forearm in adults

questions.explanation: Colles fracture is usually managed by closed reduction and casting, whereas Monteggia, Galeazzi and both-bone forearm fractures in adults need internal fixation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In which of the following injuries around the hip is there true lengthening of the concerned lower limb?
questions.explanation: Anterior hip dislocation gives true lengthening of the limb, with abduction and external rotation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Hypovolemia is a serious problem with long bone fracture. What is the average blood loss following fracture shaft of femur?
questions.explanation: A fracture of the femoral shaft can lose about 1000-1500 mL of blood.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following fracture in known as Rolando's fracture? (AIIMS May 2010)

options.C: Comminuted intra-articular fracture of base of first metacarpal

questions.explanation: Rolando fracture is a comminuted intra-articular (Y- or T-shaped) fracture of the base of the first metacarpal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tardy ulnar nerve palsy occurs as a delay equele of:

options.C: Fracture of lateral condyle of humerus in children

questions.explanation: Tardy ulnar nerve palsy follows malunion/nonunion of a lateral condyle fracture of the humerus (cubitus valgus) in children.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A pilot fracture of tibia is:

options.D: Intra-articular fracture of upper tibia (DNB Dec 2010)

questions.explanation: A pilon (plafond) fracture is an intra-articular fracture of the distal tibia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dislocation of the inferior radioulnar joint and fracture head of radius is known as
questions.explanation: Essex-Lopresti injury is a radial head fracture with distal radioulnar joint dislocation and interosseous membrane tear.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All the following are techniques for reduction of a dislocation shoulder except:
questions.explanation: Kocher, Hippocratic and surgical methods reduce a dislocated shoulder; there is no Bryant manoeuvre for shoulder reduction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bimalleolar fracture is called:
questions.explanation: Pott fracture is a bimalleolar ankle fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Clutton's joints refers to which of the following

options.C: Joint with effusion in congenital syphilis

questions.explanation: Clutton joints are painless symmetrical knee effusions in congenital syphilis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Earliest sign of Volkman's ischemic contracture is:

options.B: Pain on passive extension of fingers

questions.explanation: Pain on passive extension of the fingers is the earliest sign of Volkmann ischaemic contracture (before pallor and pulselessness).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All the following are treatment modalities for fracture neck of femur except (intracapsular)
questions.explanation: Intracapsular neck-of-femur fractures are treated by fixation or arthroplasty, not by pin traction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Main risk in fracture scaphoid is:
questions.explanation: Avascular necrosis of the proximal pole is the main risk in scaphoid fractures because of its retrograde blood supply.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Fairbank's triangle is seen in:
questions.explanation: Fairbank/Hilgenreiner triangle is a radiological sign of infantile (developmental) coxa vara.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Trethowan's sign is used in the radiological diagnosis of:

options.D: Osteochondral fracture in hip joint (AIIMS Nov 2010)

questions.explanation: Trethowan sign (Klein line missing the epiphysis) indicates slipped capital femoral epiphysis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Klippel-Feil triad does not include:
questions.explanation: Klippel-Feil triad is a short neck, low posterior hairline and restricted neck movement; a high scapula is Sprengel deformity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Clubfoot is common among:
questions.explanation: Club foot is about twice as common in boys as in girls.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: True about duputyrens contracture:
questions.explanation: Dupuytren contracture is much more common in men.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All are causes of genu varum except:
questions.explanation: Rickets, Blount disease and malunion cause genu varum; recurrent patellar dislocation is associated with genu valgum.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Candle drip appearance on X-ray is a feature of:
questions.explanation: Melorheostosis shows a candle-wax-drip hyperostosis along one limb.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Congenital muscular torticollis is caused by fibromatosis within the __________ muscle.
questions.explanation: Congenital muscular torticollis results from fibrosis of the sternocleidomastoid.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Lisfranc dislocation is:
questions.explanation: Lisfranc injury is a tarsometatarsal fracture-dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sequestrum is:
questions.explanation: A sequestrum is a piece of dead bone in chronic osteomyelitis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dupuytren's contracture is seen in:
questions.explanation: Dupuytren contracture is thickening and contracture of the palmar fascia.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Reisser's turn buckle cast is applied for correction of:
questions.explanation: The Risser turnbuckle (localizer) cast is used to correct scoliosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Approx. 40% at patients with congenital pseudoarthrosis of tibia present with lesion typical of:
questions.explanation: About 40 percent of congenital pseudarthrosis of the tibia is associated with neurofibromatosis (von Recklinghausen disease).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Fracture of clavicle is most common at:

options.A: Junction of medial 1/3 rd and lateral 2/3 rd
options.B: Junction of medial 2/3 rd and lateral 1/3 rd

questions.explanation: Clavicle fractures most often occur at the junction of the medial two-thirds and lateral one-third.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following statement regarding greenstick fracture is correct?

options.A: Fracture only occurs in rickety children

questions.explanation: A greenstick fracture is an incomplete fracture of a child's soft bone, with the opposite cortex bent but intact.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following is regarded as a definite sign of fracture?
questions.explanation: Crepitus and abnormal mobility are definite (absolute) signs of fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dinner fork deformity present in case of:

options.D: All of these Model Question Paper - 4 135

questions.explanation: Dinner-fork deformity is typical of a Colles fracture with dorsal displacement of the distal radius.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Treatment of choice in Acute myositis ossificans is:
questions.explanation: In acute myositis ossificans the part is rested; massage, passive stretching and forceful movement are avoided.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Volkmann's ischemic contracture is due to:

options.A: Injury to ulnar and median nerve
options.D: Ischemic vascular injury to the muscle (BIHAR 1991)

questions.explanation: Volkmann ischaemic contracture is due to ischaemic necrosis of forearm muscles from impaired arterial inflow or raised compartment pressure.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The most common cause of pathological fracture is:
questions.explanation: Secondary (metastatic) deposits are the commonest cause of pathological fracture in adults.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: If the osteoclast works faster than the osteoblast then you have:
questions.explanation: Osteoclastic resorption exceeding osteoblastic formation produces osteoporosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In de quervain disease the following tendons are involved:

options.A: Abductor pollicis longus + extensor pollicis brevis
options.B: Abductor pollicis brevis + extensor pollicis longus
options.C: Adductor pollicis brevis + extensor pollicis longus
options.D: Exteneor pollicis longus + flexor pollicis longus

questions.explanation: De Quervain tenosynovitis involves abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis in the first dorsal compartment.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In recurrent anterior dislocation of shoulder, the movements that causes dislocation is:
questions.explanation: Anterior shoulder dislocation recurs with abduction and external rotation of the arm.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following is the most common accessory bone of the foot?
questions.explanation: The accessory navicular (os tibiale externum) is the most frequent accessory ossicle of the foot.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Destruction and flattening of the head of femur is called:
questions.explanation: Perthes disease is avascular necrosis of the femoral head in children leading to flattening of the head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tearing of the bony attachment at the tendon or ligament is called:
questions.explanation: Avulsion is tearing of a tendon or ligament with a fragment of its bony attachment.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The most common source of bone and joint infection is:
questions.explanation: Haematogenous spread is the commonest route of bone and joint infection.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tom Smith arthritis is due to:
questions.explanation: Tom Smith arthritis is septic arthritis of the hip in infancy with destruction of the femoral head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Cold abscess is commonly due to infection of:
questions.explanation: A cold abscess is typically from spinal tuberculosis (e.g. psoas abscess).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All are causes of pathological fracture except:
questions.explanation: Osteoporosis, osteomalacia and radiation weaken bone; anaemia does not cause pathological fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Flexion, abduction and external rotation with limb length discrepancy is seen in:
questions.explanation: Anterior hip dislocation holds the limb in flexion, abduction and external rotation and may appear lengthened.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Medial epicondyle fracture results in injury to:
questions.explanation: The ulnar nerve lies behind the medial epicondyle and is injured in its fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Treatment of choice for old nonunited fracture of shaft of femur:
questions.explanation: Established non-union of the femoral shaft needs rigid fixation (plating or nailing) with bone grafting.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dashboard injury results in:
questions.explanation: A dashboard injury drives the femur backwards, causing posterior dislocation of the hip.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Gamekeeper's thumb is:

options.A: Tear in the ulnar collateral ligament of thumb

questions.explanation: Gamekeeper's thumb is a tear of the ulnar collateral ligament of the thumb MCP joint.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Intramedullary fixation is ideal in case of fracture of shaft of femur when there is:

options.C: Soft tissue interposition between fractured ends

questions.explanation: Intramedullary nailing is ideal for transverse (and short oblique) femoral shaft fractures in adults.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Stellate ganglion block is mainly used for:
questions.explanation: Stellate ganglion block is used for reflex sympathetic dystrophy (Sudeck atrophy) of the upper limb.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common cause of scoliosis is:
questions.explanation: Idiopathic scoliosis is the commonest type of scoliosis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In per rectal examination, femoral head is palpable in:
questions.explanation: In central dislocation of the hip the femoral head is driven into the pelvis and may be felt on rectal examination.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Prosthetic replacement of femoral head is indicated for one of the following sites of fractures:
questions.explanation: Prosthetic replacement of the femoral head is indicated for displaced subcapital (intracapsular) neck-of-femur fractures in the elderly.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Monteggia fracture is a fracture of:
questions.explanation: Monteggia fracture is a fracture of the proximal (upper) third of the ulna with dislocation of the radial head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A side swipe injury is usual at the:
questions.explanation: A sideswipe injury is a fracture of the elbow from the arm resting on a car window.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Von Rosen splint is used for treatment for:
questions.explanation: The von Rosen splint holds the hips abducted and is used for congenital hip dislocation in neonates.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Fatigue or stress fractures occur from repeated stress. The fractures occur in the: (AIIMS May 2009)
questions.explanation: The metatarsals (also fibula and tibia) are the commonest sites of fatigue (stress) fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following tendons is ruptured frequently after fracture of lower end of radius?
questions.explanation: Extensor pollicis longus is the tendon that most often ruptures late after a distal radius fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The source of fat emboli is probably the:
questions.explanation: The source of fat emboli after fracture is the bone marrow.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The most common injury is a 7 years old child due to fall on outstretched head is:
questions.explanation: A fall on an outstretched hand in a young child most often produces a supracondylar fracture of the humerus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Fall on outstretched hand may lead to fracture of:
questions.explanation: A fall on the outstretched hand is the classic mechanism for scaphoid fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: After an operation of femur bone chest X-ray shows wide spread mottling throughout the lung field like a snow storm. It is a diagnostic of:
questions.explanation: Fat embolism after a long-bone fracture or surgery produces a snow-storm pattern on chest X-ray.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A 40 yr old patient sustained left shoulder injury and developed anterior dislocation of shoulder joint causing sensory loss over lateral side of the arm. The nerve involve is:
questions.explanation: The axillary nerve is injured in anterior shoulder dislocation, giving sensory loss over the lateral upper arm (regimental badge area).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bankart's lesion involves:

options.A: Anterior aspect of head of humerus
options.D: Posterior aspect of head of humerus

questions.explanation: A Bankart lesion is detachment of the anterior-inferior glenoid labrum after anterior shoulder dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common bone fractured during birth:
questions.explanation: The clavicle is the bone most commonly fractured during birth.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A child with upper leg swelling with pulmonary nodule most probable diagnosis is:
questions.explanation: A child with a swollen thigh and pulmonary nodules most likely has osteosarcoma with lung metastases.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Calcium content of bone is increased in:
questions.explanation: Oestrogen supplementation after menopause increases or preserves bone calcium; immobilisation, steroids and hyperparathyroidism reduce it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bone dysplasia is due to:
questions.explanation: Bone dysplasia results from faulty development of bone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Common injury to baby is:
questions.explanation: Clavicle fracture is the common injury of the newborn.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common joint to undergo dislocation is:
questions.explanation: The shoulder is the commonest joint to dislocate.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sprengel's shoulder is due to deformity:
questions.explanation: Sprengel's shoulder is a congenital high scapula.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Ortolani's test is done for:
questions.explanation: Ortolani's test is for congenital dislocation of the hip.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Thromboangiitis obliterans is also known as:
questions.explanation: Thromboangiitis obliterans is Buerger's disease.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient comes to the clinic complaining of inflammation and pain. The physician diagnosed the patient as having bursitis and recommended iontophoresis for treatment. Which of the following is the most frequent location of bursitis?
questions.explanation: Subacromial (subdeltoid) bursitis is the commonest site of bursitis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: K.M. Varghese Company/Tidy's Physiotherapy/

12th Ed./Pg. 71

questions.question: Avascular necrosis occurs due to fracture of:
questions.explanation: Fracture of the talar neck can disrupt its blood supply and cause avascular necrosis of the talar body.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Hoppenfeld/Lippincott Williams and Wilkins/ 1st Ed./Pg. 439

questions.question: House maid's knee refers to _______.
questions.explanation: Housemaid's knee is prepatellar bursitis; clergyman's knee is infrapatellar bursitis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Tidy's Physiotherapy/K. M. Varghese Company/ 12th Ed./Pg. 70

questions.question: Which of the following is most dependable in the diagnosis of prolapsed intervertebral disc?
questions.explanation: MRI is the most reliable investigation for a prolapsed disc.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Luxatio erecta:
questions.explanation: Luxatio erecta is an inferior dislocation of the shoulder.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Bankhart's lesion involves:

options.A: Anterior aspect of the head of humerus
options.D: Posterior aspect of the head of humerus

questions.explanation: A Bankart lesion involves the anterior glenoid labrum.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Management of CDH by splintage is done with the hip placed in:
questions.explanation: Congenital hip dislocation is splinted in flexion and abduction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tuber joint angle in normal adult is:
questions.explanation: The tuber-joint (Bohler) angle of the calcaneus is normally about 25-40 degrees; about 30 is the typical value.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tuber joint angle is important in which of the following fractures?
questions.explanation: Bohler tuber-joint angle is flattened/reduced in calcaneal fractures.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A high school basketball player is treated in physical therapy after spraining her ankle. Palpation reveals an extremely painful area extending from the anterior portion of the lateral malleolus to the lateral aspect of the talar neck. The ligament most likely associated with the discomfort is the:
questions.explanation: The anterior talofibular ligament is the most commonly sprained ankle ligament (inversion injury).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Essentials of Orthopedics/Jayant Joshi/Reprint 2009/

Pg. 556

questions.question: Most common dislocation of the hip is:
questions.explanation: Posterior dislocation is by far the commonest hip dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common recurrent dislocation is seen with:
questions.explanation: The shoulder is the most common site of recurrent dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Medial meniscus is more injury, because:

options.C: Medial collateral ligament is attached to it

questions.explanation: The medial meniscus is injured more often because it is attached to the medial collateral ligament and less mobile.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopedic Physical Assessment/Magee/5th Ed./Pg. 790

questions.question: Most common bone to fracture in body is:
questions.explanation: The clavicle is the most commonly fractured bone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essential of Orthopedicss/Jayant Joshi/Reprint 2009/Pg. 74
